content.title: The Keeper's Trial
content.theme: A guarded room, and a stone the party comes back to.
content.premise: The smallest campaign that lets the bot tier's die-retry stage BIND: one mandatory encounter, and a checkpoint that fires before it. Measured 2026-08-11, no campaign or fixture in either repo had both, so the stage reported green over zero scripted deaths everywhere. This fixture exists so that stage has something to examine.
